full_judgment: 3. The facts to narrate, in brief, are that, the plaintiff-Islami Bank Bangladesh Limited filed Money Suit No. 60 of 1991 in Artha Rin Adalat No. 3 of Dhaka against the petitioners for realisation of a sum of Taka 26,03,073,92 paisa. The said suit on transfer to Artha Rin Adalat No. 4 at Dhaka was renumbered as Money Suit No. 143 of 1993.
